_readme: Hotel facts for Druid AI Assistant. This file is loaded into the concierge's system prompt on the server at startup (restart the server after editing). Any value containing TODO is treated as unknown: the concierge will NOT state it and will refer guests to the front desk instead. Replace each TODO with the confirmed fact from Mr. Rogers.

payment._note: Guests pay by card on the site (booking page, or Pay now on the confirmation page, Your stays, or a booked chat card), or at the hotel. Prototype: the card is checked in the browser only; a real card processor is needed before launch. Set to false to make the concierge say online payment is coming soon.

rooms.room_numbering: Room numbers start with the floor: 101-140 on the first floor, 201-240 on the second, 301-340 on the third.
rooms.bed_mix: About one third of rooms have a king bed. The rest are split between queen rooms and twin rooms.
rooms.master_suites: 2 large master suites on the third floor, counted within the 120 rooms.

room_types.name: The King
room_types.description: A generous king, a writing desk by the window, and a rain shower built for lingering.

room_types.name: The Double Queen
room_types.description: Room for the whole party: two queens, a lounge chair, and space to spread out on game weekend.

room_types.name: The Twin
room_types.description: Two crisply made twins for colleagues, siblings, or old roommates back for homecoming.

room_types.name: The Master Suite
room_types.beds: One king bed and a separate parlor
room_types.description: Just two of them, on the top floor: a parlor for entertaining, a soaking tub, and a view over the oaks.

rates.default_rates: Rates rise with the room (weeknight / weekend night): The Twin $90 / $135, The King $110 / $160, The Double Queen $130 / $185, The Master Suite $250 / $325.
rates.weekend_definition: Friday and Saturday nights are weekend nights.
rates.rate_notes: These are default rates. Staff can adjust rates (including special rates for specific dates) in the employee portal, so the exact total for a stay is always shown on the booking page after choosing dates. Prices shown are before taxes.
rates.taxes_and_fees: TODO: lodging tax and any fees
rates.suite_rates: The Master Suite: $250 per weeknight and $325 per weekend night by default, the most of any room.

booking.account_required: Guests need a hotel account to book: 'Sign in' in the site menu signs in or creates one (name, email, mobile phone, and a password of at least 8 characters). Booked stays are listed under 'Your stays' in the site menu.
booking.how_to_book: Two ways. On the booking page ('Book a stay' in the site menu): choose check-in and check-out dates, optionally filter by bed type (king, queen, or twin; the master suites have a king bed) and floor (first, second, or third). The page lists each open room type with the full cost of the stay and a room picked for the guest, who can choose a different one. Or in this chat: the concierge finds a room and price, then shows a card with a Confirm booking button; nothing is booked until the guest presses it.
booking.concierge_bookings_payment: Bookings made in the chat are due at check-in, or the guest can press Pay now on the booked card to pay by card online.

employee_portal._note: For staff questions on the employee portal. Keep in sync with the portal's tabs.

tabs.Reservations: Reservation list with guest details and payment status (paid / not paid); cancel reservations and log guest messages.
tabs.New reservation: Create a reservation on behalf of a guest.
tabs.Rooms & holds: Nightly room board; place and release holds on individual rooms.
tabs.Event blocks: Block groups of rooms for events.
tabs.Rates: Edit the default weeknight and weekend rates and add special rates for single dates. New rates apply to new searches only; existing reservations keep the totals they were booked at.

amenities._style: Describe amenities in an upscale, polished tone.
